versions.changelog:
Release v1.0.0.0

- Initial release of Better Subtitle Extractor
- Extract embedded subtitles and attachments during library scan or via scheduled task
- Advanced filtering: languages, codecs, SDH/forced, regex and C# override expressions
- Optional SRT conversion and parallel worker threads

Release v1.1.0.0

- Reliable extraction trigger: new hosted service subscribes to library ItemAdded/ItemUpdated events
- Fix ffmpeg extraction failure by always passing an explicit -f format for the source codec
- Graceful shutdown using a service-lifetime CancellationTokenSource
